video_title: How Steph, KD and 2018 Warriors Beat LeBron's Cavs in NBA Finals (ft. Nick Young)

quotes.speaker: Nick Young
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green's leadership style during the 2018 playoffs
quotes.excerpt: I seen a different version of Draymond being the captain.
quotes.quote: When the playoffs started, I seen a different version of Draymond being the captain. It really don't matter who it is from the star player to the last person on the bench, he going to be the same way. Yell at you, talk to you, uplift you. But when it's playoffs time, you see it's way more serious. Ain't too much laughing, too much playing around. I learned that early.

quotes.speaker: Nick Young
quotes.summary_phrase: The balance between Klay Thompson and Draymond Green's personalities
quotes.excerpt: Klay is like the good cop to Draymond's bad cop.
quotes.quote: Klay is like the good cop to Draymond's bad cop. You got to have that kind of balance. Being Draymond's being Draymond, Klay will pull you to the side and be like, 'Don't worry about that, just continue to play, things going to work out.' So he's a good dude. And KD, he don't really he's not really the leader type like the captain type. He leads by just being on the floor, but he's not really too vocal unless he kind of know you.

quotes.speaker: Nick Young
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Young's role during the 2018 playoffs
quotes.excerpt: Steve Kerr came to me and said, 'You probably won't play that much this round.'
quotes.quote: Without Steph we was a little nervous, but the Spurs are always a tough matchup. This is really like my first playoff round since my rookie season, I think. Since the Clippers. I remember earlier that day Steve Kerr came to me and said, 'You probably won't play that much this round.' But when he called my name, I got in there. I was happy to join the shot-making out there.

quotes.speaker: Nick Young
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Davis's status as a top big man in 2018
quotes.excerpt: At that point I think Anthony Davis could have been considered top two best bigs.
quotes.quote: At that point I think Anthony Davis could have been considered top two best bigs in the league. He wasn't as injury-prone as he was is now. You hear people say it's Anthony Davis's time and why you still got Kevin Durant out there, one of the best scorers to ever play this game. You can't say them type of things. He gets up for them type of games and they like to prove a point. So I think that's what he was doing that series.

quotes.speaker: Nick Young
quotes.summary_phrase: The 2018 Western Conference Finals matchup against the Houston Rockets
quotes.excerpt: Houston had been beating us during the season a couple times.
quotes.quote: Houston had been beating us during the season a couple times. They was number one. James Harden was on record pace. Chris Paul and Steph had like their little beef. In that first game it was just they thought they had it. They really thought they was going to beat us. And Klay went crazy. That's the Klay we was waiting for. They say he always have like that game five Klay or something like that. He delivered first game, so we was happy.

quotes.speaker: Nick Young
quotes.summary_phrase: The Houston Rockets' reliance on three-point shooting
quotes.excerpt: I don't know why they was so stuck on shooting threes.
quotes.quote: It said live by the three, die by the three. And if you don't change up the game plan, I think that's where we got them at. Especially with players like James Harden that can do more than just shoot threes. I don't know why they was so stuck on shooting threes, but I'm happy. And without Chris Paul, I think that's why, because Chris Paul is more of a leader. He would have got fouled, tried to do the post-up mid-range like he do. They felt confident, and I think that's where they messed up at, overly confident playing against somebody that been there, know what it takes to win.

quotes.speaker: Nick Young
quotes.summary_phrase: J.R. Smith's mistake in Game 1 of the 2018 NBA Finals
quotes.quote: Game one was J.R. Smith. I feel bad for him. He didn't know the score. He didn't know the lead. He didn't know the score. I think exactly, that's a bad mistake by J.R. Smith. At the moment I didn't feel bad for him, I was wondering what was he doing? What is he doing? LeBron had 40 something, almost 50. He was cooking. And that was the main thing we was worried about. At the free throw line we thought, 'Oh man, it's over, we let one slip out.' And then when J.R. did that, it gave us hope again.

quotes.speaker: Nick Young
quotes.summary_phrase: The rivalry between Stephen Curry and Kevin Durant for Finals MVP
quotes.excerpt: Steph and Kevin Durant was fighting over Finals MVP.
quotes.quote: Steph and Kevin Durant was fighting over Finals MVP, that's about it. You could tell they both was trying to get it without saying they trying to get it. Kevin Durant was taking it a little easy, I felt like, and Steph wasn't having that good of a game that game. So Kevin Durant just had to turn it up. And I think that's when he won Finals MVP too, after that game. It was a big night for him.

quotes.speaker: Nick Young
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Young's behavior during the 2018 championship parade
quotes.excerpt: Sometimes I be seeing videos and I didn't know I did that that day.
quotes.quote: Sometimes I be seeing videos and I didn't know I did that that day. Running to the crowd, they waited there, they there to support us, they been there all year. And I like to have fun. You come out waiting in line and just to watch us, I'm going to try my best to go out there in the crowd and let you experience it too. Swaggy, that's a swaggy do. People person. I remember coming in with the robe and no shirt. Steve Curry like, 'Uh oh, here we go. He's about to just don't get in trouble.' That's what I First thing he said, 'Just don't get in trouble.'

quotes.speaker: Nick Young
quotes.summary_phrase: Reflecting on winning the 2018 NBA championship
quotes.excerpt: I didn't know this going to be my last one and end up being my last.
quotes.quote: They don't come that often. It's very hard to win. So I didn't know this going to be my last one and end up being my last. So man, I took well enough advantage of it for sure.
